notes: Old CSS produced hint overlap in all six guest cases, including 3.375px at normal scale in this Chromium/font environment.

PR68 removes hint overlap, but unconditional flex wrapping grows the collapsed footer and puts long member names below the avatar. Its first run passed 4/12 under then-current checks; both shortcomings were visually inspected.

Final patch limits wrap to expanded mode and gives account labels a zero flex basis with truncation. Final 12/12 includes aligned expanded account rows, collapsed footer bounds, and reopening the last navigation item.
